visual_elements.description: Scaled Dot-Product Attention (small, left). Vertical pipeline inside a green rounded border. Bottom: three circles Q (red), K (blue), V (blue). Arrows from Q and K converge up into 'MatMul' (lavender box); arrow up to 'Scale' (light green); up to 'Mask (opt.)' (pink); up to 'SoftMax' (light green); up to a second 'MatMul' (lavender) at top. V sends a long straight arrow up the right side directly into the top MatMul. Thin black arrows; a mouse cursor overlaps the right border.

Multi-Head Attention (large, center). Vertical pipeline inside a green border. Bottom: three circles V (blue), K (blue), q (red), each feeding up into its own white 'Linear' box (three side by side). Each Linear feeds a stack of ~4 offset copies of a mauve box labeled 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' with a thick red border (stacking conveys h parallel heads); annotation 'h' with a cursor arrow sits at the right of the stack. Stack outputs converge into 'Concat' (light yellow box), then up into a single white 'Linear' box at top. Red dashed lines connect this panel to the small left diagram and to the attention blocks in the right-hand architecture.

Encoder–Decoder Transformer architecture (right). Bounded by a thick green rectangle; left panel light peach = Encoder, right panel light green = Decoder. Encoder bottom-to-top: red block up-arrow labeled 'Inputs' → brown 'Input Embedding' box; to its left a 'Positional Encoding' label with an icon of two circles containing sine waves, joined via a ⊕ (circle-plus) node into the embedding output; then 'Multi-Head Attention' (orange, thick red border) with V/K/Q circles beneath and 'Add & Norm' (orange) above, plus a curved residual bypass arrow on the left; then 'Feed Forward' (gray) with 'Add & Norm' above and residual bypass; gray 'N x' annotation at the right of the stack. Decoder bottom-to-top: red block up-arrow labeled 'Outputs (shifted right)' → brown 'Output Embedding'; 'Positional Encoding' label with sine-circle icon on the right joined via ⊕; 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' (purple, thick red border) with V/K/Q circles and 'Add & Norm' above + residual; 'Multi-Head Attention' (orange, thick red border) with V/K/Q circles and 'Add & Norm' above + residual — its K and V inputs come from the encoder output, and this cross-connection is emphasized by a semi-transparent yellow rectangle; 'Feed Forward' (gray) with 'Add & Norm' above + residual; then 'Linear' (green) → 'Softmax' (green) → red block up-arrow to the label 'Output Probabilities' at top. Red italic labels 'Encoder' (top-left) and 'Decoder' (top-right). A large red dashed curved arrow sweeps from the 'Decoder' label down the right edge to 'Outputs (shifted right)'. Thin curved leader lines enter this diagram from the three legend boxes and from the red 'Multi-Head Attention' label on the left half of the slide.
